# How it 'becomes real'

**Asked directly.** Asked "how will we expect to be real... what will we feel to be coming real," the answer is "massive relief it's massive massive relief." It is "actually one of the most real moments... in the journey" and the realness arrives through "having people pitch it back to you" — the moment the talk resolves into "at last i can see it."

**Texture from elsewhere.** The realness imagery is harvested from the prior day's example and chased again here: "i would like to chase that feeling in this moment as well where it's like i see an entire room of like hackathon participants and they're all vibing it out but they're all like kind of giggling at each other because they're creating the same thing but their own expressions." That will be "kind of surreal it's actually real moment" and "quite a fun moment." It echoes Mitch's ceremony "yesterday" where "the whole face of it changed but the the meaning remained," and the Blue Marble / Earthrise image where "we now see what it looks like."
